nextReadySlice.title: Wider manifest inspection projection surface
dependsOn: Dev-only manifest JSON inspection endpoint approved.
failingProof: A failing proof shows the next hosted or tooling-facing inspection surface does not yet project from the existing canonical manifest data.
A failing proof shows the new projection surface would require a boundary decision if it tries to add runtime rediscovery or a runtime-side manifest model.
nextReadySlice.reviewGate: Require human review before the next inspection surface widens into a new hosted, CLI, or tooling contract, and keep the canonical-manifest boundary intact.
